thread:
Evan (Sales): handing off NovaGrid — 12-month, 75 seats, private deploy us-west-2. Customer asks: SAML SSO, Splunk audit forwarding (JSON lines), and low p50 latency for short prompts. Renewal sensitivity flagged if perf not achieved.

Priya (CS): thanks Evan. assigning Maya as CSM. can you confirm provisioning status and any blockers? I'll create the onboarding runbook and weekly sync invite.

Evan (Sales): legal & payment complete. Onboard started. Open items: VPC peering, customer certs, Splunk HEC endpoint, and request for a reserved GPU pool during their 09:00-11:00 PDT peak window.

Maya (CSM): i'll own runbook and schedule. proposed runway: day0 networking, day3 SSO + keys, week1 pilot prompts + perf tuning, week2 go-live. Acceptance: SSO working, Splunk receives events, median latency <320ms for 10 core prompts under pilot load.

OnboardBot: provisioning update — VPC created. Remaining tasks: VPN+peering, firewall rules, certs, KMS policy, Splunk ingestion. 3/8 complete.

Ravi (Eng): saw the demo snippet Evan attached — streaming stalls around token ~700. need request_id from their env to match kernel logs. short-term mitigation: try redwood-medium-quant + prefix cache for their templates, and reserve a small dedicated pool for peak windows.

Leo (Support): opening CS ticket CS-5050 and adding ENG triage. Please paste sanitized prompts and any request_id values; I'll watch for reproducible traces.

Evan (Sales): sanitized log snippet: `2024-06-25T15:02:10Z request_id=ng-20240625-11 model=redwood-large seq=725 latency=1400ms step=kv_fetch stream_event=stall duration=1700ms`. Demo produced ~900-token output.

Ravi (Eng): thanks — can NovaGrid run this curl from their environment and paste the response header request_id? We need that to correlate with host logs.
```
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<their-long-prompt>","stream":true}' -D - | head
```

Maya (CSM): action items and owners: Priya — schedule weekly syncs (first 4 weeks); Maya — runbook + training plan; Ravi — triage ENG ticket (due 2024-06-28); Leo — track CS-5050 and escalate on >2 repros in 24h; Evan — deliver sanitized prompts & request_ids; OnboardBot/Infra — finish peering & certs.

Priya (CS): capturing enablement asks: 1) private-deploy quickstart, 2) quantization tradeoffs one-pager, 3) runbook template for SSO+Splunk mapping. NovaGrid wants the one-pager before pilot.

Leo (Support): CS-5050 created, priority=high. Watchers: @Ravi @Maya. Will link ENG ticket when created.

Ravi (Eng): preliminary suggestion: redwood-medium-quant + prefix cache, increase streaming socket timeout to 60s, and validate dedicated pool sizing. Will post config diff after repro.

OnboardBot: VPN+peering complete. Firewall PR awaiting netops review. Splunk HEC test pending customer key.

Maya (CSM): I'll post runbook link here once ready and send the standing invite. marking renewal-risk=monitor until pilot meets latency acceptance. Reopen if blockers appear before go-live.
